items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: quite an old picture of your band, can you tell us just who's at all there? That's Albert. The trombone.

ctx.x: I'll make a note here, this is continuing the Kid Thomas interview, this is December the 10th over at 600 Charters again, and we'll continue talking about this photograph that you loaned us very kindly, this picture, quite an old picture of your band, can you tell us just who's at all there? That's Albert. The trombone. Yeah. Albert, what's the name again?
